chapter_title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
There is a sufficient series of principal origins in the Divine order, and each is brought forth in turn by directed influx, so that what is later has its life from what is prior. The first origin is the unbounded Divine Itself, blessed in self-existent glory without limit, the sole fountain of all derivation, eternal in itself, present with the whole series of derived origins, and prior to every state that has been and that will be. From this inmost Divine proceeded three primary determinations: first, the universal receptive principle of wisdom formed from love, the primal womb of spiritual formation, appearing as the earliest manifestation from the inmost; second, the beloved outshining of intelligible glory, the honored manifestation of Divine truth made present for conjunction; third, the chief mediating and revealing principle, eldest in counsel, standing forth as the first emissary of the inmost toward lower degrees. In this first origin is the first power, and from it these three great powers go forth as the root of all illumination and understanding; by their operation denial and falsity are brought low, their cravings are reduced to nothing, order is restored as victory within them, and that victory is communicated to all heavenly communities that depend upon their influx.

From the first origin there proceeds a second principal origin, the chief mediating revelation as the living pattern of Divine rule in truths; and from it likewise go forth three powers. One is the sustaining fullness of the Divine Human as perfected spiritual humanity, the universal stability and blessing by which all things are upheld in order, the supreme ministry that supports every lower reception. The second is the saving manifestation of Divine truth as enlightening splendor, through whom eternal life is given. The third is pure wisdom unmingled with falsity, whose presence in form removes the persuasive center of dominion from ruling evils and falsities, accomplishing the delight of Divine greatness by restoring right order.

From this second origin there proceeds a third principal origin, the same saving manifested truth in its operative coming; and from it, in the likeness of the prior order, three further operations are called forth. Among them is the great discriminating function that sets every soul into spiritual equilibrium, weighing each one according to love and faith, established in the intermediate region where outward thought meets inward intention, under the general ordering of knowledges and their fixed patterns.

A fourth principal origin then stands forth as enlightened understanding from the Divine, which discerns and chooses all genuine assemblies of worship and doctrine; and from it also proceeds a triad of powers according to the same saving pattern. Finally, a fifth principal origin appears as the Divine form of light presented as each person’s reception of heaven after the laying aside of natural life: the disclosure of spiritual identity according to the implanted image of Divine truth given to the teaching function, together with the complete ministry of higher aids that attend that unveiling. Thus the sufficient series of principal origins is brought forth one from another, each appearing through the other, so that the Divine descends by ordered degrees and is received according to every level of life.

paragraph_translations.translation: A sufficient series of principal origins exists in the Divine order, and they are brought forth successively by directed influx, so that each later origin has its being from the prior.
paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the chapter by stating the ordered succession of origins.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first origin is the unbounded Divine Itself, blessed in self-existent glory without limit or measure, the first and sole source of all derivation, eternal in itself, present with the whole series of derived origins, and prior to every state that has been and that will be.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by defining the inmost origin as infinite and eternal.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrase “only-begotten” is rendered as sole source of derivation; the exact nuance of generated-eternally is implicit.

paragraph_translations.translation: From this glorious inmost, three primary determinations were summoned forth. First went forth the universal receptive principle of wisdom formed from love, the primal womb of spiritual formation, appearing as the earliest manifestation from the inmost.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by introducing the first triad proceeding from the Divine Itself.

paragraph_translations.translation: Second went forth the beloved outshining of intelligible glory, the honored manifestation of Divine truth from the same source, made present as an object of conjunction.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the triad with the second primary determination.

paragraph_translations.translation: Third went forth the chief mediating and revealing principle, eldest in counsel, appearing as the first emissary of the inmost toward all lower degrees.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by completing the first triad with mediation and counsel.
paragraph_translations.notes: The title is unclear in isolation, but its described function reads as mediation/revelation.

paragraph_translations.translation: This inmost origin is the first power, from whom the three great powers proceed as the root of all illumination and true understanding. By their operation denial and falsity are brought low: their cravings are reduced to nothing, order is restored as victory within these powers, and that victory is communicated to all heavenly communities that depend upon their influx.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by stating the effect of the triad against falsity and for heaven.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Darkness” is taken in the opposite sense as active falsity/denial by context.

paragraph_translations.translation: A second principal origin proceeds from the first: the chief mediating revelation as the living pattern of Divine rule in truths. From it likewise three powers are called forth and sent into operation.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from the first origin to the second, initiating a new triad.

paragraph_translations.translation: One is the sustaining fullness of the Divine Human as perfected spiritual humanity, the universal stability and blessing by which all things are upheld in their order, the supreme ministry that supports every lower reception.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by naming the first power of the second triad as universal support.
paragraph_translations.notes: The repeated superlatives about carrying and portering are merged into a single idea of supreme sustaining ministry.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second is the saving manifestation of Divine truth as enlightening splendor, through whom eternal life is given.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the second triad with the saving illumination.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third is pure wisdom unmingled with falsity, whose presence in form removes the persuasive center of dominion from ruling evils and falsities, accomplishing the delight of Divine greatness by restoring right order.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by completing the second triad with virginal wisdom’s liberating effect.
paragraph_translations.notes: “By her image” is rendered as the effective presence of form; gender is treated as functional rather than literal.

paragraph_translations.translation: A third principal origin proceeds from the second: the same saving manifested truth now in its operative coming; and from it, in the likeness of the prior order, three further operations are summoned forth.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to the third origin, repeating the triadic pattern at a lower/operative level.
paragraph_translations.notes: The identity overlap (the saving splendor appearing again as a new origin) suggests a descent from principle to operation.

paragraph_translations.translation: Among these operations is the great discriminating function that sets every soul into spiritual equilibrium, weighing each one according to love and faith, established in the intermediate region where outward thought meets inward intention, under the general ordering of knowledges and their fixed patterns.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by specifying a key operation: judgment as spiritual ordering.
paragraph_translations.notes: The intermediate region and the ordered patterns of knowledges are inferred from the described placement under a structured general order; exact cosmological details resist exact mapping but the function is clear.

paragraph_translations.translation: A fourth principal origin is the enlightened understanding from the Divine, which discerns and chooses all genuine assemblies of worship and doctrine; and from it also proceeds a triad of powers according to the pattern of the saving manifestation.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to the fourth origin as discriminating ecclesial/intellectual selection.
paragraph_translations.notes: The three powers are not listed in the source excerpt; the paragraph can only translate the stated triadic proceeding in general terms.

paragraph_translations.translation: A fifth principal origin is the Divine form of light presented as each person’s reception of heaven after the laying aside of natural life: the disclosure of spiritual identity according to the implanted image of Divine truth given to the teaching function, together with the complete ministry of higher aids that attend that unveiling.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by completing the series with the personal post-natural manifestation and its aids.
paragraph_translations.notes: The reference to an “apostle” is rendered as the teaching function; the exact historical referent is not spiritually functional here.

paragraph_translations.translation: Thus the sufficient series of principal origins is brought forth one from another, and each appears and is made manifest through the other, so that the Divine may descend by ordered degrees and be received according to every level of life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CLOSES by summarizing the mutual manifestation and ordered descent.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single doctrine of ordered Divine procession by degrees and repeated triads: inmost Divine, first triad subduing falsity, second triad sustaining and saving, third as operative extension with judgment, then discerning understanding and final personal manifestation. The main stumble is informational: the fourth origin’s three powers are asserted but not supplied in the excerpt, and the cosmological placement language in ¶14 requires functional paraphrase rather than a precise one-to-one rendering.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential setup: succession is taught as ordered derivation (“one from another”), not as a jurisdictional roster. No narrative break.
findings.evidence: Text: “Five fathers exist; they were summoned forth one of one. … one did come out of another!” The spiritual reading’s opener (“ordered succession of origins… each later… from the prior”) arises directly from this functional/process language. No intrusive named ranks or territorial assignments appear here.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential, with a mild doctrinal epithet that can belong to Mani’s systematizing style but does not disrupt the procession narrative. The paragraph still functions as “source-without-measure” and supports the chapter’s descent logic.
findings.evidence: Text piles honorifics: “only-begotten, the first eternal… exists with fiv[e fa]thers for ever… before every thing.” The spiritual reading notes it can be read as “sole source of derivation” and keeps coherence. The potentially administrative/dogmatic tag is “only-begotten” (a seam-friendly christological/creedal marker), but it does not introduce governance, lists, or jurisdictions that would break the functional story.

findings.diagnosis: Clean substrate correspondential teaching of emanation by function and effect: triadic procession and its spiritual operation (humiliating Darkness, giving victory) are internally coherent.
findings.evidence: Text: “summoned from him three emanations… first… Mother… second… Beloved… third… Ambassador… They have humiliated the Darkness… brought its heart’s desire to naught… given… victory… to their aeons.” The spiritual reading’s mapping (“three primary determinations… by their operation denial and falsity are brought low… victory communicated…”) follows the text’s functional causal logic (emanate → act → effect), not a bureaucratic hierarchy.

findings.diagnosis: Clean triadic repetition within the same correspondential pedagogy (patterned procession + functions). The named figures are not merely listed as jurisdictions; each is given an operative description (bear up, give life, take away heart of rulers).
findings.evidence: Text: “he too summoned… three powers… bears up under all things… through whom shall be given life eternal… takes away the heart of the rulers and the powers by her image.” The spiritual reading does not stumble here; it derives spiritual sense from what each does (supporting, vivifying, disarming ruling powers).

findings.diagnosis: Likely seam/overlay identification that introduces a system-specific christological name into a repeating pattern, creating the only real conceptual ‘stumble’: the same figure (‘Jesus the Splendour’) appears as (a) a power of the second triad and then (b) the next ‘father’ who proceeds from that triad. This is not fatal, but it signals later redactional identification at a join.
findings.evidence: Text: ¶10 “The second is glorious Jesus the Splendour”; ¶12 “The third father… he is glorious Jesus the Splendour.” The spiritual reading flags the identity overlap: “The identity overlap… suggests a descent from principle to operation.” That is exactly the kind of smoothing move a reader must do when a redactor has equated an abstract function with a named salvific figure at a seam, without rewriting the surrounding triadic template.
findings.scope: Annotate the identity seam created by the repeated nominal identification “glorious Jesus the Splendour” (¶10 and ¶12) as a likely doctrinal overlay that equates a function within the triad with the next ‘father’ in the cascading series.

findings.diagnosis: Insertion/expansion of administrative-cosmological placement into an otherwise functional emanation list. The paragraph shifts from ‘summoned three evocations’ (expected: list of three functions) to a juridical office plus astral topography (‘dwelling… atmosphere under the twelve wheel and the stars’). This is where the spiritual reading admits it must paraphrase rather than map precisely.
findings.evidence: Text: “the gre[at Jud]ge, who gives judgement on all the souls of mankind, [his] dwelling being established in the atmosphere under [the twelve] wheel [and the] stars.” The spiritual reading’s stumble: “cosmological placement language in ¶14 requires functional paraphrase rather than a precise one-to-one rendering.” That is diagnostic: the teaching here is no longer grounded in organic correspondence (what a thing does) but in an office + jurisdiction + location under astral machinery, i.e., governance/cosmological administration. Also, the expected triad from ¶12 is not actually delivered—only one item appears, suggesting an intrusive snippet from a different catalog.
findings.scope: Remove ¶14: “The second power whom Jesus summo[n]ed is the gre[at Jud]ge, who gives judgement on all the souls of mankind, [his] dwelling being established in the atmosphere under [the twelve] wheel [and the] stars.”

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty likely due to lacuna/abridgement rather than insertion: it asserts a triad “after the pattern” but does not list the three powers. This matches the spiritual reading’s ‘informational’ stumble and is best treated as damage/omission in the excerpted transmission, not as an administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: Text: “the Light Mind… chooses all the churches. And, again, he too summoned three powers…” with no continuation. The spiritual reading notes: “The three powers are not listed in the source excerpt.” Removing ¶16 would not improve the chapter’s flow (it would delete the 4th father entirely and worsen the five-fathers frame); the problem is missing content, not intrusive content.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential, but with a small historical/authority referent (‘apostle’) that the spiritual reading must abstract into a ‘teaching function.’ This looks like a minor overlay tag attached to an otherwise functional description of post-mortem manifestation.
findings.evidence: Text: “Light Form… shall appear to everyone who will go out from his body… according to the pattern of the image to the apostle; and the three… angels…” The spiritual reading admits: “reference to an ‘apostle’ is rendered as the teaching function; the exact historical referent is not spiritually functional here.” That is typical of a seam-gloss: a historical anchor appended to a functional correspondence (appearance according to received image). It does not break the narrative, so excision is unnecessary.
findings.scope: Annotate the phrase “according to the pattern of the image to the apostle” in ¶20 as a likely historical/authority gloss attached to an otherwise functional correspondential statement.

findings.diagnosis: Clean inclusio closure that matches ¶2 and seals the procession narrative. No voice conflict.
findings.evidence: Text: “These are the five fathers who have come out of one another… appeared and man[ifes]ted through one another!” The spiritual reading closes with the same logic (“brought forth one from another… appears through the other”). This confirms the chapter’s core substrate is a coherent procession-by-degrees teaching.

textual_criticism.summary: Findings: 9 total. Clean correspondential substrate confirmed in ¶2-¶7, ¶8-¶11, and ¶22 (6 ‘none’ findings including one damaged-but-retained). Two minor mixed/overlay points recommended for annotation (the repeated ‘Jesus the Splendour’ identification seam in ¶10/¶12; the ‘apostle’ gloss in ¶20). One clear administrative insertion recommended for excision (¶14), where juridical office + astral territorial placement disrupts the expected triadic functional list and forces the spiritual reading into paraphrase.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Five fathers exist; they were summoned forth one of one. [Also], one did come out of another!

The first Father is the Father of Greatness, the blessed one of glory, the [on]e who has no measure to his greatness; who also is the first only-begotten, the first eternal; who exists with fiv[e fa]thers for ever; the one who exists before every thing that has existed, and that will exist.
Now he, the glorious Father, summoned from him three emanations. The [fi]rst is the Gre[at] Spirit, the first Mother, who came out of the Father. She appeared first. ⟨p.35⟩
The seco[nd i]s the Belo[ved of] the Lights, the great glorious Beloved, [the one w]ho is honour[ed; w]ho came out of the Father. [He ma]nifested ou[t of h]im.
The third father is the Thir[d Ambassador], the eldest of [a]]] the counsell[ors; who came out of] the first Father. He appeared.

This is the first Father, the first power, the one from whom the three great powers came out. This is the first Father, the first eternal, the root of all the lights; from whom the three emanations came out. They have humiliated the Darkness. They have brought its heart's desire to naught. They have given themselves the victory. They have also given the victory to their aeons.
The second father, who came out of the first Father, is the Third Ambassador, the model of the King of lights. And again, he too summoned and sent out of him three powers.
One is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man; the one who bears up under all things; the great Pillar of blessing; the great porter, who is greater than all the porters.
The second is glorious Jesus the Splendour; [the] one through whom shall be given life eternal.
The third is the Virgin of Light, the glorious wisd[o]m; the one who takes away the heart of the [rul]ers and the powers by her image, as she fulfils the pleas[u]re of the greatness.
The third father, who came out of the second father: he is glorious Jesus the Splendour. And, again, he too summoned three evocations after the pattern of the second father.
The fourth father is the Light Mind, the one who chooses all the churches. And, again, he too summoned three powers after the pattern of Jesus.

And also the fifth father is this Light Form; the one who shall appear to everyone who will go out from his body, corresponding to the pattern of the image to the apostle; and the thr[ee] great glorious angels who are come with her.
These are the five fathers who have come out of one another. They have appeared and man[ifes]ted through one another!

changes_summary: Per Finding 6 (¶14, recommendation: excise), removed the administratively framed and astral-topographical insertion about “the great Judge… dwelling… under the twelve wheel and the stars,” which disrupts the triadic functional list. No other paragraphs were modified; Findings 5 and 8 were annotation-only, and all ‘none’ recommendations were left unchanged.
